column1: # Partition table for a Matter device with OTA + a separate factory partition.
# Layout fits a 4 MB flash. Two app slots (ota_0 / ota_1) let the device update
# itself over the air and roll back if an update fails. The "fctry" partition
# holds the per-device certificates + commissioning data generated locally by
# tools/gen_factory.sh — kept separate so the app image is identical on every unit.
